about: EmberEngine's own enemy ranks (the user, 2026-10-18; docs/ENEMY_RANKS.md). Every unit not on the party's side gets skills = perLevel[rank] x its level (cap 100): its weapon skill (accuracy 75 + skill, dice x (100 + skill) / 100, like a hero), Esquiva and every resistance. A class not listed is the default rank. Read by engine/world/Progression.cpp; off in the Cooker's checks.
